# Loading Button

A button that is working, saying so to someone who cannot see the spinner.

In `library/components/loading-button/` — copy `component.{html,css,js}`, read `docs.md` for why.

**Root:** `.ac-btn-loading`, `.ac-btn-loading-status`

## ARIA

- **the spinner** — `aria-hidden=true`
- **a sibling region** — `role=status`

## Keyboard

- `Enter / Space` — native: aria-disabled blocks the handler, so a second press does nothing

**States:** idle, busy — aria-busy=true and aria-disabled=true, set only while pending

## Goes wrong when

- no aria-busy and no region, so the only cue is an animation
- the disabled attribute while pending, which drops focus and announces nothing
- the label swapped to a progress word, renaming the control mid-press
- the spinner as the only cue, gone under forced colors and reduced motion

**API:** `AC.createLoadingButton(root) -> { setBusy, refresh, element, destroy }`

WCAG 1.4.1 2.1.1 2.2.2 2.4.3 2.5.3 4.1.2 · [APG](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/button/) · see also `button`, `live-region`, `status-text`
